verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local, on-device inference engine, and a product of this kind could plausibly offer a hosted cloud offload tier, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes local SSD-streamed inference, a local OpenAI-compatible server and on-device apps. Its 'tier' references are model tiers (e.g. edge0-35b), not pricing tiers, and nothing covers a hosted cloud tier, its pricing, rate limits or usage caps.
